g.text: Shaded = gap between input_size=13 and input_size=52. Dotted lines = forecast origins. WMAPE = sum of absolute errors / sum of actual sales; |bias| = |total forecast / total actual - 1|.

g.text: whose sales repeat last year's (top quartile), without stock-outs, where input_size=52 lowers the error and its forecast swings at least 50% as much as actual

g.text: sales, among series selling at least the median weekly volume in history, with no run of 13+ zero weeks (off the shelf or out of stock).
